generated: scripts/generate_policies.py from checks.json; regenerate whenever any checks.<id>.required_in_ci changes. Do not hand-edit required_checks.

SUITE.note: backend-tests.yml postgres job. Its no-backend-change sentinel reports the same context green without running the suite; a frontend-only or docs-only head is therefore not a SUITE observation.

CHANGELOG.note: backend-tests.yml's changelog_figures step checks row figures only; it does not implement the CHANGELOG diff-path coverage predicate.

RADON.note: High/max factory gate: runs the K1-pinned radon 6.0.1 `radon cc -s -j` over changed non-test Python at the recorded tree. Not a product CI job; tool absence is NOT_RUN.

BANDIT.note: High/max factory gate: runs the K1-pinned bandit 1.9.4 `bandit -r -f json -q` over changed non-test Python at the recorded tree. Not a product CI job; tool absence is NOT_RUN.

note: The only required-CI set (F-71/A51). checks.json is the source of truth; this generated list, ci.json, branch-protection.json, and check-runners.json are validated against it by scripts/generate_policies.py --check.
github_check_map_note: Hand-owned and validated by scripts/generate_policies.py: the generator never invents an entry. source=product-ci names real workflow job names read from the product worktrees and gh pr checks must observe each one SUCCESS; source=factory-gate is verified only by the factory's harness-computed check proofs; source=unmapped blocks the release. A missing mapped name is CHECKS_UNMAPPED, never a pass. High/max factory-gate ids that are not required_in_ci (RADON, BANDIT) are mapped here for the real command and never name a product GitHub job.
